whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Suto Cafe,

I noticed your cafe has amazing 4.8★ reviews at K.P Mall on Buddh Marg, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for table reservations and menu exploration.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, interactive menu, aur rooftop/ambiance gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/suto

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team Suto Cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Suto Cafe - PATNA) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your prime location at K.P Mall on Buddh Marg. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
